cards.english_title: Ladakh’s liquor protest pauses after officials accept demands

cards.english_desc: Women’s organisations paused Ladakh’s liquor protest on October 29, 2026. The administration accepted all demands in principle and requested one week. The administration gave written assurance on October 29, 2026.
cards.hook: Ladakh’s liquor protest paused after officials accepted demands.
cards.takeaway_english: The protest has paused, but the promised agreement still needs formal completion.

why_it_matters.english: The decision affects alcohol access and community concerns across Ladakh.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 라다크의 주류 접근에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The promise now depends on formal written action.

parties.english: They paused the sit-in while waiting for written final agreements.

parties.label: Ladakh administration

parties.label: Sonam Wangchuk

parties.korean: 모든 요구가 받아들여져 시위가 멈췄다고 말했다.

cards.english_title: Jio’s huge IPO wins early, but growth is next
cards.korean_desc: 지오 플랫폼스는 10월 28일 인도에 상장했다. 10년 확장이 인도 통신시장을 바꿨다. 주가는 첫날 26%, 10월 29일 5% 올랐다. 투자자들은 이제 다음 성장 동력을 찾는다.
cards.english_desc: Jio Platforms debuted on India’s NSE and BSE on October 28, 2026. Its decade-long expansion changed India’s telecom and digital services market. The stock ended 26% higher on day one, then rose another 5% on October 29. Investors now look beyond subscribers for Jio’s next growth engine.
cards.hook: Jio rose 26% on its first trading day.
cards.takeaway_english: The IPO celebration is over; investors now need evidence of durable growth.
cards.takeaway_korean: 공모 잔치는 끝났고 지속 성장이 시험대다.

why_it_matters.english: Jio’s public price now gives investors a new way to value India’s digital economy.
why_it_matters.korean: 지오 주가는 인도 디지털 경제의 새 기준이 된다.

why_it_matters.english: Future prices may depend on services, tariffs, and earnings.
why_it_matters.korean: 미래 주가는 서비스와 요금, 수익에 달릴 수 있다.

parties.label: Jio Platforms
parties.english: It completed a record Indian IPO and began trading publicly.
parties.korean: 기록적인 인도 공모 뒤 공개 거래를 시작했다.

parties.label: Investors
parties.english: They must judge whether future growth justifies the strong debut.
parties.korean: 강한 상장이 미래 성장을 정당화하는지 판단해야 한다.

parties.label: Indian telecom sector
parties.english: Jio’s listing highlights the sector’s growing technology ambitions.
parties.korean: 지오 상장은 통신업의 기술 야망을 보여준다.

views.label: Jio’s supporters
views.english: They see its network, digital services, and large user base as growth strengths.

views.label: Market analysts
views.english: They say tariff increases may matter more because easy subscriber gains could slow.
views.korean: 가입자 증가가 둔화돼 요금 인상이 중요하다고 말한다.

disagree.english: A strong debut does not prove that future earnings will match the market’s expectations.
disagree.korean: 강한 상장이 미래 수익을 보장하지는 않는다.

cards.english_title: Studio Tara makes bold jewellery quietly playful
cards.korean_desc: 스튜디오 타라는 10월 31일 벵갈루루에서 전시한다. 디자이너는 대담한 형태와 천연 보석을 선호한다. 고추 펜던트는 여러 에나멜층으로 만들어진다. 전시는 방문객에게 작품을 만지고 입어보게 한다.
cards.english_desc: Studio Tara is a Chennai jewellery brand presenting an exhibition in Bengaluru on October 31, 2026. Designer Bharathi Ramamurthy prefers bold shapes, colour, and natural untreated gemstones. Her chilli pendant uses many enamel layers, each carefully applied and fired. The exhibition invites visitors to touch, try, and discuss bespoke pieces.
cards.hook: Studio Tara makes bold jewellery with restraint.
cards.takeaway_english: Studio Tara treats playfulness as a design choice, not a lack of discipline.

why_it_matters.english: The brand shows how luxury jewellery can be colourful without becoming loud.
why_it_matters.korean: 고급 보석도 화려하지만 시끄럽지 않을 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Customers can learn how untreated stones differ from treated ones.
why_it_matters.korean: 고객은 처리되지 않은 돌을 배울 수 있다.

parties.label: Bharathi Ramamurthy
parties.english: She designs jewellery that combines bold shapes, colour, and restraint.
parties.korean: 대담한 형태와 색, 절제를 결합해 디자인한다.

parties.label: Studio Tara
parties.english: The brand is bringing fine jewellery to Bengaluru on October 31.

parties.label: Younger customers
parties.english: They are seeking design-led pieces that can be worn often.
parties.korean: 젊은 고객은 자주 입을 디자인을 찾는다.

views.label: Bharathi Ramamurthy
views.english: She says luxury can be playful, while real luxury also depends on restraint.

views.label: A more traditional view
views.english: Traditional jewellery often places more emphasis on heritage and bridal use.
views.korean: 전통 보석은 유산과 신부 장식을 더 중시한다.

disagree.english: Some customers may prefer heritage jewellery or treated stones over contemporary, untreated designs.
disagree.korean: 일부 고객은 전통 보석이나 처리된 돌을 선호할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: India chooses to bowl first in Auckland
cards.korean_desc: 인도는 5경기 시리즈를 3대 0으로 확정했다. 이샨 키샨이 돌아오고 마얀크 야다브가 교체됐다. 뉴질랜드는 카일 제이미슨을 네이선 스미스로 바꿨다.
cards.english_desc: India had already sealed the five-match series 3–0. Ishan Kishan returned, while Mayank Yadav replaced Bhuvneshwar Kumar. New Zealand replaced Kyle Jamieson with Nathan Smith.
cards.hook: India won the toss and sent New Zealand in.
cards.korean_hook: 인도가 토스 승리 뒤 뉴질랜드를 보냈다

cards.takeaway_korean: 토스보다 선수 교체가 더 오래 중요할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: New Zealand is playing to avoid a clean sweep.

cards.english_title: Pyre turns an empty village into a love story
cards.korean_desc: 아들은 28년 뒤 돌아온다지만 계속 오지 않는다. 희망이 무너지고 부부는 장작더미를 만든다. 영화는 2026년 10월 30일 인도에서 개봉했다.
cards.english_desc: Their son promises to return after 28 years, but his arrival repeatedly fails. Hope breaks down, and the couple builds their own funeral pyres. The film reached Indian cinemas on October 30, 2026.
cards.hook: Pyre follows an elderly couple awaiting their son.
cards.takeaway_english: Pyre asks whether love can hold people together as their world disappears.
cards.takeaway_korean: 파이어는 세상이 사라져도 사랑이 남는지 묻는다.

why_it_matters.english: The film connects one couple’s loneliness with villages emptied by migration.
why_it_matters.korean: 영화는 한 부부의 외로움과 이주를 연결한다.

parties.label: Padam Singh and Tulsi

parties.label: Vinod Kapri
parties.english: The director uses quiet images to explore love, ageing, and migration.
parties.korean: 감독은 조용한 장면으로 사랑과 이주를 다룬다.

cards.korean_desc: 휴대전화와 손목시계가 신원 확인을 도왔다. 시신은 부검됐지만 사망 원인은 아직 모른다. 10월 30일 수사관들은 지인을 조사했다.
cards.english_desc: A phone and wristwatch helped police identify him before the autopsy. The body was sent for autopsy, but the cause of death remains unknown. On October 30, investigators took an associate into custody for questioning.
